text: {"lessons":["Selling 25 shares of Stock B after a large gain locked in some proceeds, but a gain versus my average cost alone does not tell me whether selling is the right choice.","My account has grown overall despite monthly setbacks, reinforcing that I should not let ordinary volatility drive impulsive trades.","Since past price changes do not predict future moves and I check infrequently, I should review my portfolio deliberately and keep its risk aligned with my needs rather than trade on recent performance."]}
